summary: Found and locally reproduced a failure in the recovery/resynchronization path: a crash-recovered node whose decided index (3) lags its accepted index (6) is elected after the healthy follower compacted to 6; the follower's Prepare handling builds its log update from the preparing leader's decided index, calling get_suffix(3) below its own compacted index 6, which panics ('attempt to subtract with overflow' in omnipaxos_storage memory_storage.rs:103). Recorded the two source-settled facts (non-snapshot branch of create_log_sync; unchecked subtraction in MemoryStorage::get_suffix versus its trait contract) and an unresolved/conditional account, since the witness is local construction feedback. Next: repeat the same prefix as a fixed-input experiment in the omnipaxos package for a retained receipt.
